resources.string: Looking for SUDS on this Wi-Fi…

SUDS was not found on this Wi-Fi.

SUDS runs on a computer in your office. To use this app:
1. On that computer, start SUDS (double-click Start-SUDS) and finish the setup wizard, allowing phones to connect.
2. Put this phone on the same Wi-Fi.
3. Tap Search again.

Or scan the QR code shown under Settings → Network & devices, or type the address.

This phone is not on Wi-Fi (it is using mobile data). SUDS lives on your office network, so connect to the office Wi-Fi first.\n\nIf your county hosts SUDS on the internet, type that address below instead.

Could not reach %1$s.
%2$s

Check that SUDS is running on the computer, that phones are allowed to connect (Settings → Network & devices), and that both devices are on the same Wi-Fi.
This server uses a certificate created by your SUDS installation. Compare the fingerprint with the one shown under Settings → Network & devices, then tap Trust.\n\n%1$s
The server certificate has changed. If your administrator renewed it, forget the server and connect again.
